name: fpl-hsmem
description: ForgePlan Hindsight memory plugin for Claude Code. v3.1.0: the relay now EXPLAINS ITSELF. The MCP server sends `instructions` at handshake — the protocol's own place for the causal chain a tool description cannot carry: which of the three reads answers which question (recall ranks, list enumerates, reflect concludes), the five-step correction sequence and the two steps everyone skips, and the two facts that surprise people (retain returns before extraction; a failed retain is invisible outside memory_operations). All 9 skills now carry bilingual EN/RU descriptions with triggers in both languages — matching the house canon that 60 of the marketplace's 96 skills already follow, which fpl-hsmem did not — plus a `## Model tier` section stating the tier its hardest step needs rather than only a model name. NEW skill /memory-setup: inspects a repository and proposes the retrieval layers (LSP, indexed text, AST, semantic) and memory layers it should have, says plainly which are NOT worth it there, and never installs anything. TROUBLESHOOTING gains the bank-identity chapter: the five-minute check, two servers in one project (including a frozen plugin-cache binary), and the undocumented merge rule measured here — document-transfer SKIPS a document whose id already exists in the target and still reports success (1 of 8 moved). 27 MCP tools, 3 auto-hooks, 9 skills, 1 curator agent. Source under plugins/fpl-hsmem/src/.
